title: Arc from Rsine (Madhava arctan series)
formula: arc = R[ x - x^3/3 + x^5/5 - ... ], x = jya/kotijya, jya<=kotijya
sanskrit: इष्टज्यात्रिज्ययोर्घाताद् कोट्याप्तं प्रथमं फलम् । ज्यावर्गं गुणकं कृत्वा कोटिवर्गश्च हारकम् ॥ प्रथमादिफलेभ्योऽथ नेया फलततिर्मुहुः । एकत्र्याद्योजसङ्ख्याभिः भक्तेष्वेतेष्वनुक्रमात् ॥ ओजानां संयुतेस्त्यक्त्वा युग्मयोगं धनुर्भवेत् ।
gloss: Multiply the given Rsine by the radius and divide by the Rcosine for the first term; repeatedly multiply by sine-squared and divide by cosine-squared; divide the terms by 1, 3, 5...; subtract the sum of even-numbered terms from the sum of odd-numbered terms to get the arc. Quoted in GYB from Tantrasangraha-vyakhya II.206-209.

reference: Ch.VI s.8 Paridhyanayane samskarah, book p.53
title: Madhava end-correction (samskara) to the series
sanskrit: तस्या ऊर्ध्वगता या समसङ्ख्या तद्दलं गुणोन्ते स्यात् । तद्वर्गो रूपयुतो हारः
gloss: The even number above the last odd number, halved, is the multiplier at the end; its square plus one is the divisor.
